title: Session Pacing — Combat vs Roleplay
dataSources: Campaign sessions (`campaign:session`), NPC ledger (`npc:ledger`), loot drops (`loot:drop`), XP awards (`xp:award`).
app: Tabletop RPG telemetry — virtual-tabletop session logs (Roll20, Foundry VTT), campaign trackers (World Anvil), and XP / loot / NPC ledgers — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=campaign:session
| stats sum(combat_min) as combat, sum(roleplay_min) as roleplay, sum(exploration_min) as explore by campaign
| eval combat_pct=round(100*combat/(combat+roleplay+explore),1)
description: Breaks each session into combat, roleplay, and exploration time, revealing the true balance of your game.
value: Knowing the real pacing helps a game master match the group's taste rather than accidentally over-doing combat.
implementation: Log per-phase minutes into `index=personal`; compare combat, roleplay, and exploration share.
visualization: Stacked bar of session time by activity type.
grandmaExplanation: It shows how much of each game session is fighting versus talking and exploring, revealing your group's style.
